title: Nandi Hills Sunrise
tagline: Above the clouds before the city wakes — a quiet dawn at Karnataka's favourite hilltop.
shortDescription: Chase the sunrise above the clouds at one of Karnataka's most iconic hilltop retreats, just 60 km from Bengaluru.

narrative.heading: The Experience
paragraphs: An early start, a smooth drive through sleeping suburbs, and then the first light breaking over the Deccan plateau. This is Nandi Hills done properly — without the guesswork of parking, timing, or where to stand for the view.
Your Rishvel host keeps the pace unhurried: time for coffee, time for photographs, and time to simply watch the mist lift.

practical.title: Best time
practical.content: October through February offers the clearest sunrise skies. Monsoon months can be dramatic but misty — dress in layers.

practical.content: All transport is included from Bengaluru. Pickup times are shared the day before your trip.

practical.content: An early morning with some walking on paved paths. Moderate hilltop breeze; bring a light jacket.

practical.content: Comfortable shoes, a warm layer, sunglasses, and a fully charged phone for photos.

practical.content: Weekend mornings can be busy at the summit; we adjust timing slightly when needed to keep the experience calm.

title: Mysore Heritage Day
tagline: An elegant journey through royal heritage, local flavours, and the quieter side of Mysore.
shortDescription: Explore the grandeur of Mysore Palace, vibrant markets, and serene Chamundi Hills — curated into one unforgettable day from Bengaluru.

narrative.heading: The Experience
paragraphs: Mysore rewards travellers who know where to linger — inside the palace courtyards, at a market flower stall, on the drive up Chamundi Hill when the city spreads below you. We built this day around those moments, not a checklist of every monument on a map.
Your Rishvel host handles timing, tickets guidance, and the small local stops that turn a sightseeing trip into something that feels personal and unhurried.

practical.title: Best time
practical.content: October to March is ideal — pleasant for walking and palace visits. Dasara season is spectacular but busy; enquire early if you plan to travel during festival weeks.

practical.title: Getting there
practical.content: Private vehicle from Bengaluru (approximately 3 hours each way with breaks). All driving is included; palace entry fees are paid locally unless otherwise confirmed.

practical.title: What to expect
practical.content: A full day with moderate walking on palace and market floors. Dress for warm afternoons; temples and palace may require modest clothing and shoe removal where marked.

practical.title: What to carry
practical.content: Comfortable walking shoes, sun protection, a light scarf for temple visits, and a bottle of water.

practical.title: Food
practical.content: Try Mysore masala dosa, bisibele bath, and filter coffee. Your host will steer you toward trusted local kitchens rather than highway stops.

practical.title: Shopping
practical.content: Mysore silk, sandalwood products, and market spices are popular. We allow time for browsing if you wish — no pressured shop stops.

practical.title: Good to know
practical.content: Palace illumination (evening lights) is on specific days — ask when enquiring if you want to extend for the night view; it may affect return timing.
